body:
Handoff from MMR-38 (`docs/runtime-navigation.md`):
- **Port-to-gate distance is a cost.** `GetPortToGateDistanceForSettlement` reads the All navigation cache, which returns path length plus 50 per embark/disembark (MMR-17: 55–56 for ports 5–6 units away). MMR-38 checks the port envelope on the engine path's length instead: at most 12.5 units, exactly one switch. The worst cases are 8.1 units in world A and 11.25 in world B.
- **Build caches after final positions.** Build the settlement navigation caches only after settlement and port positions are final; take them from the navigation report's `static.points`.
- **Face counts.** A compiled world's navmesh has about 16.4k–16.7k faces, within your provisional 32,768-face limit. The fixture-specific cache checks in `GeneratedMapSupport.RegisterNavigationCaches` (exact fixture settlement ids) still need replacing for production worlds.
